material.densityAndFlame: Independent fixed unit white volume emission, zero absorption/scattering. No blackbody or palette.
material.signedHeat: RGB=(max(H,0),0,max(-H,0)) unit emission; no value-derived normalization. Raw H, not RNA .5H or flame-derived T.
material.units: One native metre authoring normalization; not calibrated radiometry or measured temperature.

camera.required: Actual native oblique capture matrix/projection, independently pinned before a render permit. Inverse signed-axis mapping and translation from input-spec.

renderer.attributeConversion: Unproved; blocks render until exact source and conversion witness are reviewed.

outputs.preview: Fixed Standard/sRGB, exposure0/gamma1; no auto-normalization. May clip and must be labelled; no beauty/native acceptance.

acceptance: Diagnostic only. No native QA, motion proof, quality score, R/O or rendering-cost credit.
